liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Friend of the Devil** (1 other source): Played acoustic, on set two track 13 of this recording [2]

## The recordings

- **DeadCo2015.12.30.audmtx** (recommended): source not stated; 18 songs; 175 min [1]
- **deadco2015-12-30.2015-12-30flac16**: audience recording; 17 songs; 175 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **deadco2015-12-30**: audience recording; 17 songs; 175 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]
- **deadandcompany2015-12-30.4mic.wharfratjoe.134944.flac16**: source not stated; 17 songs; 176 min; rated 4.75/5 by 4 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls this one of the best tapes they've heard from this tour; Reviewer finds the audience recording's sound excellent, avoiding the poor capture audience tapes sometimes suffer [6][9]

## Around the show

- Bobby's voice was not holding up well this night, reportedly worse the following night [6]

## Tapers and lineage

- **DeadCo2015.12.30.audmtx**: Source 1 taped by wharfratjoe: Busman BSC1-K11 into UA-5 XY plus M-Audio Pulsar II XY, to Tascam DR-70 at 24/48; Source 2 taped by Richie Stankiewicz using DPA 4021 (70% cardioid) and DPA 4061 (30% omni) microphones [1]
- **deadco2015-12-30.2015-12-30flac16**: taped by Richie Stankiewicz; transferred by Richie Stankiewicz; source: FOB>AUD 4 Mic Mix [2]. Also: Recorded front-of-board in the sweet spot, 60-70 feet center, with DPA mics; recorded and transferred by Richie Stankiewicz; Reviewer notes an added source, linking an etree database entry numbered 134924 [2][7]
- **deadco2015-12-30**: taped by Richie Stankiewicz; transferred by Richie Stankiewicz; source: FOB>AUD 4 Mic Mix [3]. Also: Reviewer notes an added source, linking an etree database entry numbered 134924 [8]
- **deadandcompany2015-12-30.4mic.wharfratjoe.134944.flac16**: taped by wharfratjoe; transferred by wharfratjoe; source: Busman BSC1-K11 > UA-5 XY + M-Audio PulsarII XY > Tascam DR-70 @ 24/48 [4]
